Edit the existing 4x4 green-background game sprite source sheet. Preserve exactly 16 separate existing pixel-art cels, their grid placement and cell assignment, the pure bright green background, same Hắc Thiết adult chibi identity, red sash, pose scale, fur, face, feet and fixed slightly overhead camera. Repaint ONLY the hammer, its hand grip as needed, and the four melee contact poses in row 3 as specified. Main physical change: DOUBLE the length of the hammer shaft in every cel (100% longer). It must read as a genuine long war-hammer, with a thick chestnut handle about 55–65% of standing body height where seen side-on, long clearly visible dark leather-wrapped wood, BOTH a visible long section and a compact unchanged-sized gray iron head with copper Y inlay, and a short capped end beyond the gripping hand. Keep exactly one hammer firmly held in one hand. Do not enlarge the head or change the hero. Use diagonal or upright carry in rows 1–2, rather than cropping a low long weapon at the floor. Give weapon and character ample green clearance in each of the four equal columns and four equal rows; you may subtly reposition a whole cel inside its cell to accommodate the weapon but do not shrink body proportions. Use NO VFX, motion trails, sparks, labels, shadows or divider lines.
Keep row 1 as 2 idle and 2 guard poses, row 2 as the 4 alternating steps in the existing drawing, and row 4 as 4 ranged prep/point/recoil/recover poses with the long hammer visibly held, keeping all of their original facings.
Row 3 new action contact poses, left-to-right order is mandatory: 1 FORWARD THRUST, lunge forwards with hammer held straight forward along facing, at belt-to-chest height; 2 SWEEP TO HERO'S LEFT, waist-level lateral sweeping hammer follow-through with shoulders rotated, clearly distinct from a thrust; 3 RISING UPPERCUT, lift the hammer from low near the hip to high in a decisive curved swing, finish head high in the air with torso rising; 4 OVERHEAD SLAM landing, deep lean and the hammer angled forward/down with head at the ground, no VFX. Keep each cel isolated on green. Only the steel hammer plus wooden shaft changes size. Return the entire square sheet.
This sheet's fixed facing is right. Its body must still face right in all sixteen cels. The existing pointing direction remains the actor's forward direction.

Create one original pixel-art electricity sprite-sheet strip, precisely 4 equal columns, one row, on flat pure chroma green #00ff00. Use the supplied Côn Luân pixel-art board solely as style reference. Draw only a localized, low-to-ground jagged VIOLET electric hammer impact burst in a 2D elevated three-quarter wuxia RPG view. No hero, weapon, floor, shadow, text, divider or grid. Four unique phases left to right: (1) compact violet-white crack and small impact flash at center, (2) explosive bright lavender core and large bright violet branching bolts radiating out sideways as a flattened circular area on the ground, (3) separate jagged purple arcs breaking and reaching farther around center, (4) a few dim violet fading embers. Sharp stepwise hard pixel art, dark amethyst edges and lavender white core; no gold, orange or pink. All cels centered and isolated in their equal column, with large green gutters and no artwork across boundaries. Fairly low, wide impact, never draw a sky bolt.
